_comment: Types round 4 (docs/notes/types_4.md): LUA.DLL's parser tables (bison 1.x output of Lua 3.1's lua.stx: YYNTBASE 49, YYNRULES 102, YYNSTATES 184, 44 nonterminals, YYLAST 262, tokens up to 284) and lobject.c's table of hash sizes. yydefgoto and yypgoto are indexed by yyr1[n] - YYNTBASE; the compiler folded the subtraction into the base, so the code addresses them 98 bytes early (inside yydefact and yypact), where Ghidra had put the labels. Round 6 (types_6.md): ltm.c's validevents[tag][event] (8 tags by 18 events, 0 or 1: which tag methods a tag allows; indexed with -tag), signed bytes as yytranslate.
